answer: An agent may bill only after holding one scarce, non-transferable intake slip at a shared harbor through a full settlement window. Inspectors mark the first delivery with a saffron dye whose daily batch code cannot be pooled across names. The counterparty issues a walnut certificate bound to that delivery hash and burned on first use. Registrars accept only the slip-batch-certificate triple and slash any wallet that underwrites two slips. Every extra identity therefore consumes a real waiting berth, a unique daily mark, and a one-time grain, so a sybil factory cannot cheaply multiply voices.
